title: About the Career Assessment
subtitle: Understand how this assessment works, why it matters, and how it guides your future career.

whySection.title: Why Take This Assessment?
whySection.point1Desc: Uncover careers that align with what you enjoy doing and what you are naturally good at.
whySection.point2Desc: Questions use everyday situations with clear choices. No complex academic or psychological jargon.
whySection.point3Desc: Get concrete career paths, job roles, and entry steps tailored to your strengths.

howItWorks.title: How the Assessment Works
howItWorks.step1Desc: Read each straightforward question and pick the option that feels most natural to you. There are no right or wrong answers.
howItWorks.step2Desc: There is strictly no countdown timer. If you need a break, your answers are saved automatically so you can resume anytime.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Explore career categories and specific job roles that suit your unique interests and strengths.

guarantee.title: Our Promise to You
guarantee.desc: Your progress is always saved safely. You can start on your phone and finish on a computer, or pause whenever you need.

readyTitle: Ready to Discover Your Natural Strengths?
readyDesc: Welcome, {{name}}! Your account is verified and ready. You can now proceed to take the career assessment. There are no right or wrong answers — choose what fits you best.

activeSession.title: You Have Already Started Your Assessment!
activeSession.subtitle: Your previous answers have been safely saved. You can continue directly from where you left off, or check your profile in the dashboard.
activeSession.profileTip: Tip: You can also access your dashboard at any time by clicking your profile icon or the Dashboard button in the navigation bar.
activeSession.readyResumeDesc: Welcome back, {{name}}! Pick up right where you left off without losing a single answer.
